newsitem.title: USA: Washington Mutual to buy United Western.
newsitem.headline: Washington Mutual to buy United Western.

text.p: Washington Mutual Inc said Monday it has signed a deal to acquire privately held United Western Financial Group Inc of Salt Lake City, Utah, and two units for $80.3 million in cash.
One unit, United Savings Bank, operates nine branches and the other, Western Mortgage Lender, has seven offices.
Through the deal, Washington Mutual aims at becoming a leading mortgage lender in Utah. It currently operates 16 full-service financial centers and a loan center in the state.
In March, the company signed a merger pact with Federal Savings Bank, based in Ogden. That deal is still pending.
United Savings Bank operates seven branches in the Greater Salt Lake City area. The two other branches are located in St. George, Utah, and Idaho Falls, Idaho.

Western Mortgage Loan operates two offices in Salt Lake City, and one each in Portland, Ore., Boise, Idaho and Las Vegas and Reno, Nevada. It also operates a loan office in Missoula, Mont., under the United Western name.
Western Mortgage services more than $4.3 billion in loans, including $3.5 billion in which it owns the servicing rights.
